value.rationale: The motivating numerical gap is that unbiased generator sampling and even exactly correct mean trajectories need not control any individual long-time numerical probability vector. The complete two-state classification identifies the sole mean-exact sampling strategy, its exact sharp O(sqrt(h)) finite-horizon RMS error constant, and a natural coarse-step threshold beyond which the invariant output is a singular Cantor measure. The positive forbidden-equilibrium gap is a substantive, algorithm-relevant failure mode invisible to mean bias tests; it is neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor a known-table recomputation.
